stopReason: A local Supabase stack is running and its project label matches the repo, but its database is not confirmed synthetic-only. The current app environment points to a non-loopback Supabase URL, the local Supabase CLI is unavailable, and other build-time NEXT_PUBLIC_* values were not fully validated. The database was not queried; the comparison stopped before build or application startup.

conditions: A: build from the hosted commit with ShellWebVitalsReporter mounted.
B: same isolated worktree and build configuration, bypassing only the ShellWebVitalsReporter mount; no other source, dependency, environment, or data change.
predeclaredComparison.fixedInteraction: On synthetic dashboard.clients, focus the client search field; type three synthetic characters with 350 ms gaps and do not submit; navigate Dashboard then Clients once; reload once.
predeclaredComparison.capture: Use the same Edge version, viewport, synthetic account/data, local target, and clean browser state. Record 60 seconds from the first input in native Edge Performance. Run A then B. Keep the temporary B-only edit in the managed hosted-commit worktree and do not commit it.
prerequisites: Confirm the existing local stack is disposable and synthetic-only without querying client rows, or provide a fresh isolated local target; do not install a CLI to work around the unresolved data classification.

Before package installation, build, or app startup, verify without printing values that NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL and every NEXT_PUBLIC_* service URL are loopback/safe, and that Supabase keys belong only to this local synthetic target. Do not reuse the main checkout .env.local.
The isolated worktree has no node_modules. If required, install exactly from its committed lockfile using npm ci without modifying package or lock files.
predeclaredComparison.measurement: Record input dispatch timestamps, renderer-main RunTask count/max/total for tasks >=50 ms, and call trees. Preserve inclusive and self time separately; compare only the same 60-second window and sequence.

decisionRules.candidateSupportedLocally: A contains a renderer-main task >=500 ms during the fixed interaction with a 1555 Web Vitals U/m frame; B has no renderer-main task >=250 ms and its total >=50 ms RunTask time is at least 50 percent lower than A.
decisionRules.candidateNotSupportedAsSoleLocalTrigger: B still contains a renderer-main task >=500 ms and its total >=50 ms RunTask time is at least 80 percent of A.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A has no >=500 ms renderer-main task; the input/navigation/reload sequence differs; required input/profile markers are missing; or the result meets neither numeric rule above. Local non-reproduction must not be used to dismiss the reported system-wide symptom.

stopConditions: Stop before startup if Supabase URL is not verified loopback or credentials are not local-only synthetic.
Do not create or migrate a database without separate explicit authorization.
Do not use real client data, hosted services, or live providers.
Do not deploy, change dependencies or secrets, or implement a runtime fix as part of this comparison.

nextRequiredInput: Confirm the running manu-ai-local database is disposable and contains synthetic-only data, and provide local-only build-time configuration. If that cannot be confirmed without reading client rows, use a fresh isolated local synthetic target instead. If setup requires migrations, obtain separate explicit migration authorization first.
conclusion: The trace-based candidate assessment is complete, but the controlled A/B comparison did not run. Causality remains unproven.
